compliments: Today is yours for the taking.
The best is yet to come.
Little by little, one travels far.
Every day is a fresh start.
It's your story — turn the page.
You're exactly where you need to be.
Leap, and the net will appear.
You were made for days like this.
Today has your name on it.

prompts.title: What have you been putting off because it felt too small to matter?
prompts.body: Do that one today, before anything bigger.

prompts.title: Tell someone the specific thing they did well.
prompts.body: Not the work in general. The exact part you noticed.

prompts.title: What would you do this afternoon if you weren't worried about doing it wrong?
prompts.body: Start there, even for ten minutes.

prompts.title: Leave one thing unfinished tonight on purpose.
prompts.body: It will still be there tomorrow, and so will you.

prompts.title: Who taught you something you still use, that you never thanked?
prompts.body: Send them one sentence today.

prompts.title: Ask a teammate how they're actually doing, and wait for the real answer.
prompts.body: Not the one that fits between meetings.

prompts.title: What's a decision you're circling instead of making?
prompts.body: Pick the reversible option and move. You can always adjust.

prompts.title: Step away from the screen for ten minutes with nothing to check.
prompts.body: No phone either. Just the ten minutes.

prompts.title: What did you do this month that you'd be proud to explain to a stranger?
prompts.body: Write it down somewhere you'll see it again.

prompts.title: Give credit out loud for something someone else built.
prompts.body: In the same meeting or thread where you'd usually take it.

prompts.title: What's one thing you know now that you wish you'd known a year ago?
prompts.body: Someone near you is about to learn it the hard way. Tell them first.

prompts.title: End work on time today, even if the list isn't done.
prompts.body: The list is never done. That's not the signal to stay.

prompts.title: What are you avoiding because the first step is unclear?
prompts.body: You don't need the whole path. Just name the first step.

prompts.title: Notice who usually goes unnoticed, and say something true about their work.
prompts.body: Specific beats nice.

prompts.title: What's something you believed strongly a year ago that you've since changed your mind about?
prompts.body: That's not inconsistency. That's the system working.

prompts.title: Eat lunch away from your desk today.
prompts.body: Away from the screen counts as away.

prompts.title: What would you build if you knew it wouldn't need to be perfect?
prompts.body: Sketch it, badly, for five minutes.

prompts.title: Forgive yourself for the thing you've been replaying.
prompts.body: You already learned what it had to teach you.

prompts.title: What's a question you've stopped asking because you assumed you knew the answer?
prompts.body: Ask it again. See if the answer's still the same.

prompts.title: Say no to one thing today that doesn't deserve your evening.
prompts.body: You don't owe a reason. "Not this time" is a full sentence.

prompts.title: What's the smallest version of the big thing you're waiting to start?
prompts.body: Do the small version today.

prompts.title: Let someone else be right today, even when you could win the point.
prompts.body: Being right and being kind aren't always the same move.

prompts.title: What's something you did today that no one is going to notice?
prompts.body: Notice it yourself. That's allowed.

prompts.title: Text someone you've been meaning to check on.
prompts.body: Not a big message. Just "thinking of you" is enough.

flowers.name: Sunflower
flowers.meaning: Faces the light on purpose. A steady kind of optimism.

flowers.name: Cherry Blossom
flowers.meaning: Blooms fast, falls fast, and is loved precisely because it doesn't last.

flowers.name: Lotus
flowers.meaning: Grows up clean through muddy water. Nothing about its start shows in the flower.

flowers.name: Lavender
flowers.meaning: Calm that you can smell. Also famously hard to kill.

flowers.name: Peony
flowers.meaning: Full, a little too much, and unapologetic about it.

flowers.name: Daisy
flowers.meaning: Small and plain-looking, and somehow the flower everyone trusts.

flowers.name: Orchid
flowers.meaning: Takes years to bloom. Worth the wait every time.

flowers.name: Tulip
flowers.meaning: Arrives in a crowd of identical stems and still stands out.

flowers.name: Iris
flowers.meaning: Named for the messenger of the gods. Built to be noticed.

flowers.name: Chrysanthemum
flowers.meaning: Blooms latest in the year, when most things have already given up.

flowers.name: Marigold
flowers.meaning: Thrives in poor soil. Toughness that looks like cheerfulness.

flowers.name: Poppy
flowers.meaning: Grows wild in disturbed ground. The flower that shows up after things get hard.

flowers.name: Camellia
flowers.meaning: Flowers in winter, which is the whole point of it.

flowers.name: Jasmine
flowers.meaning: Opens at night and gives its best scent when no one is watching.

flowers.name: Hydrangea
flowers.meaning: Changes color with the soil under it. Shaped by where it's planted, not less itself for it.

flowers.name: Wisteria
flowers.meaning: Climbs slowly for years before the display everyone remembers.

flowers.name: Magnolia
flowers.meaning: One of the oldest flowering plants alive. Dignity that predates the bees.

flowers.name: Freesia
flowers.meaning: Small flower, disproportionately good smell. Punches above its size.

flowers.name: Anemone
flowers.meaning: Named for the wind. Moves easily without breaking.

flowers.name: Ranunculus
flowers.meaning: Looks hand-folded, petal by petal. Patience made visible.

flowers.name: Gerbera
flowers.meaning: Plain shape, loud color. Doesn't overthink it.

flowers.name: Snapdragon
flowers.meaning: Squeeze the bloom and it opens like a mouth. Playful, a little unexpected.

flowers.name: Zinnia
flowers.meaning: Bred to be nearly impossible to kill in the heat. Reliable by design.

flowers.name: Carnation
flowers.meaning: Ruffled and long-lasting. The flower that outstays the bouquet.

flowers.name: Bluebell
flowers.meaning: Carpets a whole forest floor for two weeks a year, then waits eleven months.

flowers.name: Hibiscus
flowers.meaning: Lasts one day, fully open. Some things are worth doing all the way even if briefly.

flowers.name: Forget-Me-Not
flowers.meaning: Named for exactly what it asks of you.

flowers.name: Amaryllis
flowers.meaning: Grows from a bulb with nothing visible, then suddenly a foot of bloom.

flowers.name: Dahlia
flowers.meaning: Petals in perfect spirals. Structure and softness at once.

flowers.name: Protea
flowers.meaning: Survives wildfire; some species need fire to seed. Built for the hard reset.

careNudges.title: Water break
careNudges.body: A full glass, not a sip.

careNudges.title: Refill time
careNudges.body: Top up the glass on your desk, or go get one.

careNudges.title: Eyes off the screen
careNudges.body: Look at something six meters away for twenty seconds.

careNudges.title: Blink on purpose
careNudges.body: Screens cut your blink rate in half — a few slow blinks reset the dryness.

careNudges.title: Stretch it out
careNudges.body: Reach both arms overhead and lean slowly side to side.

careNudges.title: Unhunch
careNudges.body: Roll your shoulders back three times and let them drop.

careNudges.title: Stand up
careNudges.body: Just stand. Walk to the window and back if you feel like it.

careNudges.title: Shake it off
careNudges.body: Thirty seconds of moving however feels good — stairs, a lap, a stretch.

careNudges.title: Tea o'clock
careNudges.body: Put the kettle on and let it steep properly this time.

careNudges.title: Warm cup
careNudges.body: Coffee, tea, or water — whichever sounds good right now.

careNudges.title: Bio break
careNudges.body: You've been sitting a while — go if you need to.

careNudges.title: Quick trip
careNudges.body: No shame in stepping away for a minute.

careNudges.title: Three slow breaths
careNudges.body: In for four counts, out for six. Repeat twice more.

careNudges.title: Unclench your jaw
careNudges.body: Notice your shoulders and jaw — most people are holding tension right now.

careNudges.title: Check your spine
careNudges.body: Feet flat, back supported, screen at eye level. Adjust one thing.

careNudges.title: Sit up tall
careNudges.body: A small reset now saves a bigger ache later.
